steps.description: Unit of measure EA exists and is the unit of every item module.
Weighted-average item model groups exist, one stocked and one non-stocked.
Item group APV2 exists and carries the inventory posting profiles.
Inventory posting profiles resolve to seeded main accounts.
Site, warehouse and the default inventory dimension exist.
Zero-rate item tax group IV2-ZERO exists, so costing is asserted without tax noise.
Fiscal-year-scoped released products exist for the stocked and the service item.
Storage and tracking dimension groups are assigned to the stocked item only.
Default order settings exist for the stocked item.
Inventory close and cost-settlement number sequences are allocatable.
